name: Square Spiral
description: An expanding square (Archimedean) spiral — the boxy cousin of Spiral. Radius grows with t while the squircle map keeps the turns square.
author: @swiftner

formulas.x: x = cos(t * TAU * 4) / max(abs(cos(t * TAU * 4)), abs(sin(t * TAU * 4))) * t * {x:200}
formulas.y: y = sin(t * TAU * 4) / max(abs(cos(t * TAU * 4)), abs(sin(t * TAU * 4))) * t * {y:200}
